targetCapabilities.title: Bi-directional Electrothermal Feedback Loop
targetCapabilities.description: Iterative co-simulation updating circuit parameters R(T) and diode saturation parameters from spatial thermal field temperatures until convergence.

targetCapabilities.title: Relaxed Picard / Fixed-Point Iteration
targetCapabilities.description: Numerical damping via under-relaxation parameter theta in (0, 1] to prevent oscillation in stiff nonlinear electrothermal regimes.

targetCapabilities.title: Rigorous Tri-Residual Convergence
targetCapabilities.description: Simultaneous satisfaction of delta_T < 1e-3 K, delta_R / R < 1e-4, and KCL current residual <= 1e-7 A.

targetCapabilities.title: Global Energy Conservation Verification
targetCapabilities.description: Auditing that total Joule heat generated across the circuit exactly equals heat expelled across convective boundaries and sinks (relative error <= 0.1%).

targetCapabilities.title: Independent Analytical Reference Parity
targetCapabilities.description: Verification against closed-form algebraic root solution of self-heating resistor without invoking numerical co-simulation engine.
